'''Shon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as an Imperial tech specialist for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
When the Imperials were able take over the [[Green Jedi Enclave]] and establish a garrison in the structure during the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the Republic employed stealth troopers in an attempt to drive out the Imperials. Shon determined that the Republic was utilizing an incredibly advanced cloaking technology, but managed to modify a stealth field generator to disrupt other fields. He tasked an Imperial team to trip the stealth troopers' advantages.
